definitions.explanation: Having a small body frame. Describes a person who is short and slight in build. Generally used as a neutral or gentle description, not rude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小柄|こがら}な⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧だ。
{小柄|こがら}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
{小柄|こがら}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かして、⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧すばやく⟦{動|うご}ける→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: Using her small frame to advantage, she can move quickly even in tight spaces.

notes:
USAGE:
{小柄|こがら} is a polite and neutral way to describe someone who is small in stature. It is not rude or offensive. It is the opposite of ⟦{大柄|おおがら}→大柄：17177_oogara⟧ (large build, big-framed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小柄|こがら}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — a small-framed person
- {小柄|こがら}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ — a small body
- {小柄|こがら}な⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧ — a petite woman

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ simply means short in height. {小柄|こがら} describes the overall frame being small, not just height. ⟦{華奢|きゃしゃ}→華奢：09070_kyasha⟧ means slender and delicate, emphasizing fragility rather than just small size.
